DIOSDADO 1. GARVIDA, M.D. Municipal Mayor Munipality of Bangui, Province of Ilocos Norte Dear Mayor Garvida: This has reference to your letter dated IO September 2014 requesting this Department's legal opinion regarding the need for prior authorization from the Sanggumang Bayan concerning the donation to the Municipality of a new welcome arc now being constructed by private company North Luzon Renewable Energy Corp. (NLERC). Please be advised that Section 22 (c) of Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 explicitly requires prior authorization by the Sanggunian concerned before any contract may be entered into by the local chief executive in behalf of the local government unit. Thus: "Section 22. - (a) E local entunit as a (2) xx x; ration shall h the follo (4) To acquire and con vey real or personal property; (5) To enter into contracts; and (b) Xxx x. (c) Unless otherwise provided in this Code, no contract may be entered into by the local chief executive in behalf of the local government unit without A legible copy ofsuch contract shall be posted at a conspicuous place in the provincial capitol or the city, m unicipal or barangay hall. (d) X x x. " (Italics and underscoring supplied) Applying the above-quoted provision to your query, it is our view that you should have secured prior authorization from the Sanggunian Bayan before any contract of donation has been entered into or, in your case, before you acceded and gave your consent to the commencement of the construction of your Municipality's welcome arc by NLERC. Further, this department differs from your view that "no contract (was) made between the LGU and NLERC, but only a mutual understanding x x x to settle the

da we (sic) of the arc, x x x." Note must be made that a mutual understanding can rea cly be considered as a binding contract between and among the parties concerned ' on the very definition of a contract under the law. Article 1305 of the Civil Code provides for the definition of a contract, to wit: "Article 1305. whereby one binds himself,' with respect to the other, to give something or to render some service. " (Italics and underscoring supplied) Considering that there was already a meeting of minds between NLERC — manifested by its offer to construct the subject welcome arc — and your office — manifested by your acceptance of its offer and eventual consent Tor it to proceed with the construction thereof-- it becomes readily clear that a contract had been perfected and resulted therefrom. Thus, prior authorization from the Sanggunian Bayan, as mandated by the above-quoted provision of the law, becomes a necessity. Trusting that the foregoing provided guidance to your concern. Very truly yours, A STERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary DILGOUSLG 201+12-03773 1.s:25/11/17 Copy furnished: DIR. JULIE J.
